blocks.orig: Board a semi-submarine and experience an immersive underwater adventure around the beautiful Bawe Island, in the middle of the Indian Ocean on the west of Zanzibar’s capital Stone Town. A semi-submarine vessel stays afloat but has space below the waterline featuring underwater windows that allow you to explore the reef from the comfort of your seat! Afterwards, a speedboat will take you for a picnic brunch, sunbathing, and swimming on a secluded sandbank.
blocks.html: Step aboard a semi-submarine for an immersive underwater adventure around lovely Bawe Island, out in the Indian Ocean to the west of Stone Town, the capital of Zanzibar. A semi-submarine floats on the surface but has a space below the waterline with underwater windows, so you can explore the reef without leaving your seat! After that, a speedboat takes you to a secluded sandbank for a picnic brunch, sunbathing and a swim.
